content:
Laredo College students who want to spend next spring studying in Spain have a deadline on the calendar: applications for the Spring 2027 Study Abroad Program are open through Friday, Nov. 6, according to Laredo College.

The program takes students to Sevilla, Granada, Córdoba, Málaga and Madrid, where coursework and cultural engagement are built around the cities themselves. The college presents the trip as a chance to build communication, leadership and critical-thinking skills, and to bring a broader global perspective back to a border community workforce.

Students can apply through the Study Abroad Program website at go.laredo.edu/studyabroad. For more information, the college lists Global Learning and Leadership Initiatives Coordinator Bianca Cubriel at bianca.cubriel@laredo.edu or (956) 794-4414, or in person at Memorial Hall, room 219, on the Ft. McIntosh Campus.

Laredo College's first study abroad cohort traveled to Spain as an extension of the classroom, navigating a new culture and environment firsthand, the college said. The Spring 2027 program follows that same model, combining academic, professional and community engagement across Spain.

Sources:

  • Laredo College, "Deadline approaching for LC Spring 2027 Study Abroad Program applications," Oct. 27, 2026
